question: How much does the IELTS course cost?
answer: IELTS Academic and IELTS General Training are both Rs 35,000 for the full 8-week course. That covers classroom instruction, sample study material and bi-weekly full-length mock tests.

question: How much does the PTE Academic course cost?
answer: PTE Academic is Rs 28,000 for the full 8-week course. PTE students also subscribe to a computer-delivered practice portal, which is charged separately by package.

question: How much does the Spoken English course cost?
answer: Spoken English is Rs 26,000 for the full 8-week course.

question: How much does IELTS Life Skills A1 cost?
answer: IELTS Life Skills A1 is Rs 26,000 for the full 8-week course. It is the test commonly required for a UK spouse or marriage visa.

question: What is the fee for UKVI IELTS, PTE Core, OET, Oxford ELLT, LanguageCert or the IT short courses?
answer: These courses are offered but their exact fee is confirmed by the office. As a guide, fees run roughly Rs 10,000 to 20,000 per month, or Rs 20,000 to 40,000 for a two-month course, depending on the course. Share your name and number for the exact figure, or WhatsApp 0332 241 0155.

question: Are there any hidden or additional charges?
answer: The course fee is all-inclusive. It covers classroom instruction, sample study material, access to 4skills.co for replaying listening audio, and full-length bi-weekly mock tests with results. There are no additional administrative fees. The computer-delivered practice portal is a separate optional subscription. Fee is not refundable.

question: Can I pay the fee in instalments?
answer: Fee is charged in full at the time of admission. Fee is not refundable. For anything specific to your situation, please speak to the office on 0332 241 0155.

question: What does the 4skills.app practice portal cost?
answer: 4skills.app is our computer-delivered practice and mock-test portal. Subscription packages are listed on 4skills.app itself, and there is a free trial for a limited set of IELTS computer-delivered tests. You can subscribe to the portal without enrolling in a class, though we recommend coaching first.

question: How long is the course?
answer: Standard duration is 8 weeks for all courses. A fast-track option can complete the preparation in about one month by taking double classes; the fee stays the same 8-week package fee.

question: What time are the classes?
answer: Batches run Monday to Friday with morning, afternoon and evening slots. The exact timing for each batch is confirmed by the office, since it changes with each intake.

question: When is the institute open?
answer: Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Saturday 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM for enquiries and admissions only, no classes. Closed on Sunday.

question: Where are you located?
answer: 96-97A First Floor, Kohinoor One Plaza, Jaranwala Road, Faisalabad, Punjab 38000. Please book an appointment before visiting. View on Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/iGJmsU1VvnyZCYcH6

question: How do I contact 4Skills?
answer: Phone and WhatsApp: 0332 241 0155. Email: englishlanguageclub.faisalabad@gmail.com. Office hours are Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM and Saturday 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

question: How do I enrol?
answer: Three steps. First, fill in the admission form for your course. Second, pay the fee for your package and subscribe to your portal package. Third, take the evaluation test, which usually takes two to three hours. After that you are invited to join your class.

question: Is there an entry or assessment test?
answer: Yes. Every candidate takes a mandatory assessment test at enrolment. It identifies your current band or score equivalent and your strengths and weaknesses in each module, so the learning path can be adjusted to you.

question: When does the next batch start?
answer: Batch start dates are confirmed by the office, since they depend on the course and the slot you pick. Leave your name and number and someone will call you with the next start date, or WhatsApp 0332 241 0155.

question: What courses do you offer?
answer: IELTS Academic, IELTS General Training, UKVI IELTS, IELTS Life Skills A1, PTE Academic, PTE Core, OET, Spoken English, plus Oxford ELLT, LanguageCert, TOEFL, Duolingo English Test, PSI English Tests and IT short courses. We also offer study-abroad services through affiliated consultants.

question: How many students are in a class?
answer: Class sizes are limited to 15 to 20 students per batch, so every student gets direct interaction, speaking practice and trainer feedback.

question: How many mock tests are included?
answer: Bi-weekly full-length mock tests are included, run under real exam conditions and marked against the official band descriptors. Additional mock tests are available on the 4skills.app portal.

question: Should I take IELTS or PTE?
answer: Neither is objectively easier, they just test English differently. IELTS suits people who prefer human-marked speaking and writing. PTE is fully computer-delivered with AI scoring and faster results. We give unbiased counselling and a diagnostic test to help you pick the right one for your visa or institution.

question: Do you offer online classes?
answer: On-campus classes are recommended because results are better, and they include training, practice and computer-delivered practice of all modules. Online mode is available for students in other towns who cannot relocate. Call 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM to discuss.

question: Will a university, employer or visa office accept this test?
answer: We cannot confirm which test a particular university, employer or visa office accepts, and their requirements change. Please confirm that directly with the institution or your consultant. Once you know which test you need, we can help you prepare for it.

question: How do I register for my IELTS or PTE test? Do you help with booking?
answer: 4Skills is an affiliated partner and registers tests on your behalf with the British Council, IDP and AEO for IELTS, and with Pearson for PTE. Visit the office with your documents and the test fee, and the team will complete the registration for you.

question: How long has 4Skills been running?
answer: 4Skills has been working in this field since 2017.

question: What are the trainers' qualifications?
answer: Instructors are certified for IELTS through IDP and for PTE through Pearson, and have also completed trainer training with the British Council and AEO. They have years of direct training experience and detailed knowledge of the official assessment criteria.

question: What results do your students get?
answer: Standards are kept the same for every candidate. In 2025 and 2026 our students received high-achiever awards from IDP. Recent results are on the success stories page at 4skills.co.

question: Can I finish the course faster than 8 weeks?
answer: Yes. A fast-track option covers the same 8-week syllabus in about one month with double classes, at the same fee. Availability depends on the current batch, so the office confirms it.

question: How do I get feedback on my writing and speaking?
answer: Writing and speaking lectures cover the format and standards first. Sample practice tests are then done in class and reviewed together to find mistake areas, and the portal gives detailed feedback on each writing practice test. Speaking is practised through question and answer sessions, debates, presentations, and at least one full-length individual interview before the real test.

question: How do you teach Academic Writing Task 1?
answer: Dedicated multimedia lectures and structured classes cover every Task 1 visual form: bar charts, line graphs, pie charts, complex tables, maps and process diagrams. You build up to writing them gradually.

question: Is the reading practice material like the real exam?
answer: Yes. We use official practice tests and authentic Cambridge-style academic passages. Exercises focus on strategy: skimming, scanning, keyword mapping, and handling tricky question types like True/False/Not Given.

question: How are General Training classes different from Academic?
answer: Listening and Speaking are trained together since the strategies are the same. General Training candidates get separate instruction and test material for GT Reading, which uses everyday workplace and social texts, and for GT Writing Task 1, which is letter writing.

question: Will I learn formal and informal letter formats?
answer: Yes. GT Writing instruction covers structural frameworks, standard openings and closings, tone, and prompt analysis for every letter category, including complaints, requests, applications and personal notes.

question: Do you have computer labs and AI practice tools for PTE?
answer: Yes. PTE classes are structured around a dedicated software portal. Students subscribe to it and get AI-driven practice with real-time automated scoring for oral fluency, pronunciation and written discourse.

question: Do you teach PTE templates and strategies?
answer: We teach you how to handle each question type rather than relying on fake templates. The PTE curriculum focuses on high-yield tactics, enabling skills and time-management for the integrated tasks.

question: Who runs 4Skills? / Who is the director?
answer: 4Skills was founded by Muhammad Arif, who is the Director and an IELTS trainer. He has been running the institute since 2017 and teaches on the IELTS courses himself. His trainer certifications are listed on the team page.

question: Is 4Skills certified, and what are the trainers qualified in?
answer: 4Skills holds two official partnerships: IDP IELTS Official Alliance Member, certified July 2024 and signed by the IDP Country Director Pakistan, and a Pearson Official Member Certificate. Muhammad Arif, Director and IELTS trainer, has completed trainer training with the British Council, IDP, AEO Pakistan, Pearson, LanguageCert and ETS TOEFL between 2024 and 2026. Note the British Council and AEO documents are trainer-training attendance certificates, not partnerships, and must never be described as partnerships or accreditation.
